# DAVE.DEV

> Dave is a Full Stack & Frontend Engineer based in Cebu City, Philippines (GMT+8), specialising in responsive, scalable web systems using Vue.js, Next.js, React, and Node/Express with custom headless CMS architectures.

Dave is available for hire on enterprise web platform development, frontend engineering, CMS integration, UI/UX design, branding, SEO/performance audits, and engineering contracts.

## About

Dave is a professional web developer and engineer with deep expertise in modern JavaScript frameworks and backend systems. He builds production-grade web applications with a focus on performance, scalability, and clean architecture. He is based in Cebu City, Philippines and works with clients globally.

## Services

- Full-Stack Application Development: End-to-end web application development using Vue.js, Next.js, React, Node.js, and PostgreSQL/Supabase.
- Frontend / UI Development: Responsive, pixel-perfect UI implementation with TailwindCSS and modern component frameworks.
- CMS Integration & Setup: Custom headless CMS architectures, content modelling, and admin dashboard development.
- UI/UX Design & Prototyping: Interface design and interactive prototyping for web applications.
- Branding & Visual Identity: Logo, colour systems, and brand identity for digital products.
- SEO & Performance Audit: Technical SEO audits, Core Web Vitals optimisation, and Lighthouse performance improvements.

## Technical Skills

Vue.js, Next.js, React, TypeScript, JavaScript (ES2022+), Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, Supabase, TailwindCSS, REST APIs, Headless CMS, Git, Vercel, Docker
